name: shop-end-card
title: Shop End Card
description: The closing card of a small-shop video on a clean white page: a logo tile, the shop name, a tagline, address, opening hours, a contact line and a call-to-action button settle in one after another and hold still.
useWhen: The last seconds of a video for a shop, stall or service that needs name, address, hours and a way to order.
A call to action should land clearly and then stay readable.
avoidWhen: You only need a single line or a URL: use a text block.
The ending should be a product shot or a big offer: put it in the scene before this card.
author: Mosio

variables.label: Shop name
variables.description: Name of the shop, set large.

variables.label: Tagline
variables.description: One short line under the name. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Address
variables.description: Short address. Leave empty to hide the row.

variables.label: Opening hours
variables.description: Opening hours. Leave empty to hide the row.

variables.label: Contact
variables.description: Contact line, for example a chat number. Leave empty to hide the row.

variables.label: Call to action
variables.description: Text of the button. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Logo tile
variables.description: Show the drawn shop-front logo tile above the name.

variables.label: Accent colour
variables.description: Accent: the button and the logo glyph.
